acceptance: A tuning page generated from a docs-data fixture with no aliases has no dangling sentence; the no-aliases golden is updated
context:
Moved from the BenchBox core tracker, where it was filed on 2026-10-29, when this repository gained its own tracker.

2026-11-02: Done in PR #105 (merge 6435170d6a). tuning-matrix.ts omits the aliases sentence when the alias map is empty; no-aliases golden regenerated (diff removes only that sentence and a blank line). The real bundle has one global map with 7 entries, so it is never empty today. npm test -w website passed; ci green before merge.
description: Found 2026-10-28 while adding generator goldens. With an empty alias list, website/src/lib/docs-generators/tuning-matrix.ts renders the sentence "Aliases resolve to another platform's entry: ." with nothing after the colon. The checked-in golden (website/tests/docs-generators-golden/no-aliases/) now pins that wording. Omit the sentence when the list is empty (or render an explicit none), then regenerate the golden with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 and review the diff. Check whether the real bundle ever has an empty alias list; if never, the fix is still cheap and prevents a malformed published page.
